name: Locomotion With No Type
_breaks: No `type`, so nothing knows which driver to run. Also carries `body_lean`, which is not a `locomotion` field — a plausible misremembering of `lean_into_turn`, and the warning has to name it rather than silently ignore it. The pair is deliberate: the unknown-field warning is emitted before the type check bails, so this asset proves the bail does not swallow it.
